verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees, on Avenue George V in the heart of Paris.
verified_facts.excerpt: is within walking distance of historical landmarks, including the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysées, and is located in the heart of Paris on Avenue George V.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomed guests such as Winston Churchill, Marlene Dietrich and royalty.
verified_facts.excerpt: it welcomed icons like Winston Churchill, Marlene Dietrich, and royalty

verified_facts.text: The architecture of Le Patio has remained intact since 1929 and is protected as a historical monument by the Batiments de France.
verified_facts.excerpt: The beauty and elegance of the Patio's architecture, which has remained intact since its inauguration in 1929, are unique and protected by the 'Bâtiments de France' (the French architectural review board) as a historical monument.

verified_facts.text: The composer Chopin lived in the building that stood where the hotel is now, in an apartment just above the current Patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: the famous composer resided in the building that stood in place of the hotel and his apartment was located just above the current Patio.

verified_facts.text: Le Patio is a courtyard at the heart of the hotel adorned with thousands of mosaics, for a meal or a cocktail.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the very heart of the hotel, this elegant courtyard adorned with thousands of mosaics is an oasis of tranquility for a meal or refreshing cocktail.

verified_facts.text: Le Patio, with its walkways and garden, can be enjoyed all year round.
verified_facts.excerpt: The gastronomic experience at the Prince de Galles can be enjoyed all year round on Le Patio with its walkways and garden.

verified_facts.text: Many of the rooms and suites have private balconies with views of the Paris cityscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: many of which include private balconies with stunning views of the Paris cityscape

verified_facts.text: The marble bathrooms feature mosaics inspired by the Art Deco era.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our sleek marble bathrooms that feature mosaics inspired by the Art Deco era

verified_facts.text: Rooms have toiletries from the Lalique collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: plush terry cloth robes and slippers and toiletries from the Lalique collection

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a Nespresso coffee machine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Energize your day with your room's Nespresso coffee machine and Lalique bathroom amenities

verified_facts.text: Created in collaboration with Lalique, the Suite Lalique by Patrick Hellmann has views of Paris including the Eiffel Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: in collaboration with Lalique, Prince de Galles presents the exclusive Suite Lalique by Patrick Hellmann, boasting stunning views of Paris, including the iconic Eiffel Tower.

verified_facts.text: The Suite Lalique marble bathroom has a free-standing bathtub with a view of the Eiffel Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: the marble bathroom is the crowning feature of this exceptional suite, with its free-standing bathtub and a view of the Eiffel Tower.

verified_facts.text: The Suite d'Or has gold and black accents celebrating French craftsmanship.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Suite d’Or is a spacious, elegant oasis with gold and black accents celebrating French craftsmanship.

verified_facts.text: The Macassar Suite living area has a fireplace and powder blue walls with molding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautiful molding adds a touch of elegance to the powder blue walls and the separate living and sitting areas boast a majestic fireplace and plush furniture

verified_facts.text: The Wellness Suite was created with expert practitioners from CALMA PARIS, known for its Mediterranean orange-blossom method.
verified_facts.excerpt: created with expert practitioners from CALMA PARIS. Renowned for its Mediterranean orange-blossom method

verified_facts.text: CALMA PARIS treatments use 100% natural, organic and vegan ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Driven by advanced concentrated formulas and 100% natural, organic, and vegan ingredients

verified_facts.text: A Wellness Suite takes the place of a full spa and offers personalized treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Wellness suite takes the place of a full fledged spa and offers personalized treatments.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24/7 with personalized coaching.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in 24/7 fitness access with cutting-edge equipment and personalized coaching.

verified_facts.text: The concierge team are members of Les Clefs d'Or.
verified_facts.excerpt: As certified destination experts and proud members of Les Clefs d’Or

verified_facts.text: The lobby has gold-leaf chandeliers and marble floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: into the airy lobby with gold-leaf chandeliers and superb marble floors

verified_facts.text: Michelin-starred chef Akira Back opened his first restaurant in Europe at the hotel in 2022.
verified_facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred Chef Akira Back chose Prince de Galles, Paris for his first restaurant in Europe. Opened in 2022

verified_facts.text: Restaurant & Bar 19.20 by Norbert Tarayre is centered on Paris in the 1920s.
verified_facts.excerpt: Centered on Paris in the 1920s, Restaurant & Bar 19.20 by Norbert Tarayre pairs contemporary decor with a joie de vivre atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: The Gatsby Brunch takes place every Sunday, themed on the Roaring Twenties.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every Sunday, step into the glamour of the Roaring Twenties through an immersive experience

verified_facts.text: Interiors include makassar ebony furniture, art deco mosaics and 1920s and '30s fashion photography.
verified_facts.excerpt: two-toned carpets, colored armchairs, makassar ebony furniture, art deco mosaics, and 1920s and '30s fashion photography

verified_facts.text: Each bathroom has a different marble scheme, from Italian Carrara to black and pink marble from the Pyrenees.
verified_facts.excerpt: There is a different marble scheme in every bathroom—from seamless swaths of Italian Carrara to entire walls and floors covered in black and pink marble from the Pyrenées.

verified_facts.text: The neighborhood boutiques include Dior, Cartier, Louis Vuitton, Chanel and Bulgari.
verified_facts.excerpt: the exclusive local boutiques such as Dior, Cartier, Louis Vuitton, Chanel or Bulgari

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served at Le Patio for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Le Patio for a fee.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets Welcome.
